summary: Harden evidence-verify Git subprocesses against repository-configured OpenPGP and X.509 verifier programs while preserving SSH signature verification.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Evidence verification continues to use SSH signatures and the explicitly supplied allowed-signers and revocation files. The Git helper ignores global and system configuration and refuses OpenPGP and X.509 verifier execution.
